terms.en: Telling a story in the past
terms.de: Eine Geschichte in der Vergangenheit erzählen

en.title: Telling a story in the past
en.summary: A past story combines the simple past, the past continuous and the past perfect.

paragraphs: A story in the past uses three tenses together. The simple past moves the story forward, the past continuous sets the scene, and the past perfect gives events that happened earlier.

items: The sun **was shining** and birds **were singing**. (scene)
I **opened** the door and **walked** in. (main events)
Somebody **had left** a note on the table. (earlier)

blocks.html:
TenseRole in the storyExample
simple pastmain events, in orderShe picked up the phone and called.
past continuousbackground, scene, interrupted actionIt was raining when she left.
past perfectevents before the story beginsShe had forgotten her umbrella.

paragraphs: It was a dark night, and the wind was blowing hard. Maria walked slowly along the empty street. She had missed the last bus, and she was thinking about her warm bed. Suddenly she heard a noise behind her. She stopped and turned round.

Notice how the sentences about what happened (walked, heard, stopped, turned) move the story on, while the others (was blowing, was thinking) describe the scene, and had missed explains how she came to be there.

items: **while, as, when**: events at the same time
**suddenly, at that moment**: a surprising event
**by then, by that time**: the past perfect
Do not change tense without a reason: **She walked in and sees him** → **She walked in and saw him.**
Use the past perfect only for the earlier events; the main story stays in the simple past.
Wrong: **When he came, I was cooking and then I saw him.** Right: **When he came, I was cooking. I saw him and stopped.**

ro.title: A povesti la trecut
ro.summary: Când povestim la trecut, combinăm imperfectul pentru descriere, perfectul compus pentru acțiuni și mai-mult-ca-perfectul pentru acțiuni anterioare.

paragraphs: Când spunem o poveste la trecut, folosim trei timpuri diferite. Imperfectul descrie decorul și acțiunile în desfășurare. Perfectul compus prezintă evenimentele principale, pas cu pas. Mai-mult-ca-perfectul arată o acțiune mai veche din trecut.

items: **Am deschis** ușa și am intrat în casă.

paragraphs: Folosiți cuvinte de legătură pentru a ordona întâmplările. Cuvinte ca „dintr-odată” anunță adesea un eveniment neașteptat. Păstrați timpul trecut și nu săriți la prezent fără motiv.
